data.define: Said to show something is perfect, like a great meal.

misuse.text: Don't say 'chef's kiss' about burnt toast.

data.l1_hook: これ食べて感想教えて！ まさに「chef's kiss」な瞬間です。
data.l1_ex: そのスープは「chef's kiss」だった。

native.tip: “chef's kiss” = 完璧. 例文: “The soup was chef's kiss.”
